product.title: Houston Ghosts and Hauntings Walking Tour

description.text: Walk downtown Houston after dark on a guided ghost tour covering Market Square Park, historic bars, and landmark hotels tied to local haunt lore. Guides share researched stories while keeping the group moving through compact downtown blocks. Stops include Market Square Park, La Carafe, Hotel ICON, Downtown Haunt Circuit. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
